data.note: long-running feature request for LSP client support; closed won't-do in favor of external micro-plugin-lsp
long thread tracking effort to get micro packaged for apt/Debian; eventually succeeded, micro entered official Debian repos and Ubuntu 20.04

long thread on autocompletion; core added simple buffer-word autocomplete natively (2019) plus command/filename completion, but full language-aware autocomplete deferred to LSP plugins (see lsp-support)
long debate on adding a file-tree/sidebar to core; community leaned toward keeping micro a lean editor (not IDE) and resolved via plugins (filetree-plugin, filemanager)
long-running copy/paste confusion thread; explains micro's clipboard model (internal/terminal/external, xclip/xsel dependency, ssh limitations), later improved with OSC52 terminal clipboard support
